name: clawagent
description: Termux-native OpenClaw host for Android. Composes the shared @openclaw/* cores; never imports src/, extensions/, or openclaw/plugin-sdk.

scripts.test: cd .. && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts ClawAgent

clawagent.comment: Two records, neither of which npm reads. `reusedPackages` names the @openclaw/* cores this host composes; they are deliberately absent from `dependencies` because the entry point resolves them from the checkout's packages/ directory, and because the only protocol that could express that link (`workspace:*`) is pnpm-only — declaring it there makes `npm install`, the install path the README gives a phone user, fail outright with EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL. `externalDependenciesOfReusedCores` lists the npm packages those cores import; they are absent from the cores' own installs when the roots here do not reach them, so they are declared directly. src/runtime/reused-packages.ts recomputes both sets and test/boundary.test.ts fails on any drift, including a non-registry protocol in `dependencies`.
